Forme juridique de l'attributaire Le marché public sera conclu : – soit avec un opérateur économique unique ; 8/17 – soit avec un groupement d’opérateurs économiques conjoint ou solidaire. En cas de groupement conjoint, le mandataire sera solidaire, pour l'exécution du marché public, de chacun des membres du groupement, pour ses obligations contractuelles à l'égard de l’acheteur. La composition du groupement ne peut être modifiée entre la remise des offres et la date de signature du contrat. 2-6. ant indiquant qu'il ne tombe pas sous le coup d'une interdiction de soumissionner. La notification du marché public emporte acceptation du sous-traitant et agrément des conditions de paiement. Les prestations de services sont prouvées par des attestations du destinataire ou, à défaut, par une déclaration de l'opérateur économique ; • Une déclaration indiquant les effectifs moyens annuels du candidat et l'importance du personnel d'encadrement pendant les trois dernières années ; • Une description de l'outillage, du matériel et de l'équipement technique dont le candidat disposera pour la réalisation du marché public. Dans ce cas, il est également demandé de fournir dans le pli une copie de l’intégralité de la candidature et de l’offre sur support électronique (Clé USB, CD, DVD…). 6.1.5 - Signature des documents Le pouvoir adjudicateur a décidé d e privilégier une signature électronique pour la finalisation du contrat ! La signature électronique est exigée pour les pièces suivantes : - Lettre de candidature (DC1) ; - Acte d’engagement (AE). Les pièces transmises et pour lesquelles une signature est exigée peuvent être revêtues de la signature électronique sécurisée dès le dépôt de l’offre , en utilisant un certificat de signature électronique. Ce certificat doit être délivré par une autorité de certification accréditée et permettre de faire le lien entre une personne physique et le document signé électroniquement. Les candidats, qui auront choisi de ne pas signer les pièces de l’offre (pour lesquelles une signature est exigée) lors de leur dépôt, sont informés que l’attribution du marché donnera systématiquement lieu à la signature électronique de ces dernières. references_experience.text: (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

Fixture scripts can also be used within the running application, facilitating manual/exploratory testing (discussed below). The Department also provides a number of other libraries to manage fixtures. The simple “fake data” library can be used in unit and other tests to select/generate a random value for use within a test. Integration tests should not hard-code any officer user Ids, instead the “officer leasing” library allows an unused user/officer account to be exclusively used, with logic to automatically check/reset the officer’s certificates for signed recorded actions. Production code should never use system time directly, instead it should be possible to “mock the clock” in tests. For the BOMi application the “Programmable Clock” service provides this capability. Keeping Tests Green Whenever a project starts the Department will ensure that the initial CI pipeline for their project branch (of the Trunk) is green. B2B: The DSP API and Electronic Exchange of Social Security Information (EESSI) APIs enable business-to-business integration to other Departments, public service bodies and to other European countries. Other supporting systems that make up the technology landscape include Facial Imaging Matching System (FIMS), and the General Registers Office (GRO) system. The BOMi’s scope will continue to grow in both size and complexity to (a) support the Department’s expanding Digital requirements, (b) consolidate its technology stack, and (c) continue to support new or changing legislation as it arises. The current technology platform is .NET Framework 4.x deployed to Windows Servers. In due course these will be upgraded to .NET 6 (aka .NET Core) at which time the Department will plan to deploy these systems, either for testing and/or production, on Linux/Docker when appropriate. New systems also target .NET 6 for the same purpose. The Department’s development resources are a combination of the Department’s internal staff, partnering with a number of service providers. The Senior Technical Development Advisor (TDA Lot 1) has acted as an independent strategic technical advisor across the IS Division, providing guidance on a range of SDLC and architecture related concerns. The TDA (Lot 1) helped product and platform teams deliver secure, resilient, and high-quality solutions more rapidly through the adoption of modern engineering practices and automation technologies. The TDA (Lot 1) role focused on shaping governance process and technical direction and procurement activities, translating complex technical issues into clear recommendations and implementation plans. Key areas of contribution included Continuous Integration, Release and Deployment, SDLC platform engineering, application security process and governance, Test Data Management modernisation, Developer Experience, contract testing, and SDLC platform architecture, particularly for the Department’s BOMi Platform. The TDA (Lot 1) also played a significant role in defining product and platform ownership models, associated team charters and enhanced IT governance approaches. In addition, the role supported various technical procurements through technical assessments.

We ensure that Ireland's environment is protected, and we monitor changes in environmental trends to detect early warning signs of neglect or deterioration. Protecting our environment is a huge responsibility, and we work with a number of organisations that carry out specific environmental functions. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. This commitment is reflected in our own activities through an Environmental Management System (EMS), certified to ISO 14001 since 2010, which supports good environmental management in our everyday operations. The EPA is an independent public body established under the Environmental Protection Agency Act, 1992. deliverables_scope.text: in cadrul propunerii tehnice descrierea detaliata a metodologiei proprii de management de proiect pe care o va utiliza in cadrul contractului și echipa de proiect formata din personal specializat. Ofertantul trebuie să prezinte in cadrul propunerii tehnice planul (calendarul) de derulare pentru prestarea serviciilor pe toate cele Sistemul Electronic de Achizitii Publice Sistemul Electronic de Achizitii Publice, 30.09.2026 09:38 Pagina 24 20 de luni. Planul trebuie sa conțină toate activitățile pe care le va desfășura precum și etapele/sub etapele determinante de realizare a activităților, dependentele dintre activități, reperele de proiect (milestones), rezultatele activităților și alocarea resurselor in vederea prestării serviciilor ofertate astfel încât sa fie atinse obiectivele contractului. Ofertantul trebuie să propună planul de derulare a activităților cât mai detaliat posibil și să răspundă cerințelor de etapizare și înscriere in termenele de realizare ale contractului. Planul care va fi prezentat împreuna cu oferta trebuie sa fie dezvoltat folosind tipurile de activități menționate mai sus împreuna cu alte activități considerate a fi necesare. REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST
(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTING SERVICES)

SRI LANKA
SRI LANKA PORTS AND LOGISTICS DEVELOPMENT PROJECT  

Grant No.: TF0D0285 

Assignment Title: Consultancy Service for Operational Readiness, Systems Integration, Commissioning, Go-Live Management and Operational Stabilization of East Container Terminal (ECT)

Reference No.: LK-SLPA-GFPP-577531-CS-INDV

The Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka has received financing from the World Bank
toward the Sri Lanka Ports and Logistics Development Project, and intends to apply part of the

The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate issue experience. The scope of this requirement encompasses both body and foot scanning to modernize the issuance of both uniforms and footwear. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. Waterford and Wexford Education and Training Board (WWETB) provides a comprehensive range of education and training services throughout Waterford and Wexford and is the largest education and training provider in counties Waterford and Wexford. WWETB’s educational and training provision includes second-level schools, primary school, further education colleges and a range of adult and further education centres delivering education and training programmes, Post Leaving Certificate Courses (PLCs), Youthreach centres, Outdoor Education and Youth Services. WWETB places learning and the learner at the heart of its educational provision. For more information on WWETB and ETBI go to http://waterfordwexford.etb.ie/ and www.etbi.ie For more information on ETBs and ETBI go to www.etbi.ie See Appendix 4 for details of all schools and centres under WWETB remit. Στο αντικείμενο της σύμβασης περιλαμβάνεται η παροχή της απαιτούμενης υποδομής VMware, των αναγκαίων υπολογιστικών, αποθηκευτικών και δικτυακών πόρων, καθώς και η εγκατάσταση, παραμετροποίηση και λειτουργία της υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery. Οι τεχνικές προδιαγραφές τόσο του Κέντρου Δεδομένων όσο και των υπηρεσιών περιγράφονται στο Έντυπο 9 - ΠΙΝΑΚΑΣ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ. Η λύση θα υποστηρίζει τη συνεχή αναπαραγωγή (replication) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών του Πανεπιστημίου προς το περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου, με χρήση του λογισμικού Veeam Backup and Replication, ώστε να διασφαλίζεται η δυνατότητα ανάκτησης των κρίσιμων πληροφοριακών συστημάτων σε περίπτωση σοβαρής διακοπής λειτουργίας ή καταστροφής του κύριου Κέντρου Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου Κύπρου. Στόχος είναι η συνέχιση της παροχής υπηρεσιών μέσω διαδικτύου προς την Πανεπιστημιακή κοινότητα και το κοινό, με τον ελάχιστο δυνατό χρόνο διακοπής. Η λύση θα πρέπει να παρέχει τη δυνατότητα ενεργοποίησης (failover) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών στο περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου όταν και εφόσον κριθεί αναγκαίο, καθώς και δυνατότητα ασφαλούς επαναφοράς (failback) στο κύριο Κέντρο Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου μετά την αποκατάσταση

ουσας Αρχής. Κατά τη διάρκεια της επίσκεψης, τα άτομα της Αναθέτουσας Αρχής θα έχουν συναντήσεις με τους αρμόδιους μηχανικούς του DR Datacenter και θα παρουσιαστούν η υποδομή και η αρχιτεκτονική του χώρου, οι μηχανισμοί πλεονασμού και διαθεσιμότητας, καθώς και οι διαδικασίες Disaster Recovery. Παράλληλα, θα παρουσιαστούν οι διαδικασίες replication, failover/failback και αποκατάστασης των συστημάτων σε περίπτωση καταστροφής ή διακοπής λειτουργίας. Ο Ανάδοχος πρέπει να συμπεριλάβει στην προσφορά του όλα τα τυχών έξοδα για την επίσκεψη (κόστος μεταφοράς, διαμονής, γεύματα κτλ.). deliverables_scope.text: ..................... ................................ ........ 6 6 Kreditering ................................ ................................ ................................ ..... 6 1 Krav om elektronisk fakturering I medhold av Forskrift om elektronisk faktura i offentlige anskaffelser (2.april 2019) er EHF faktura obligatorisk ved fakturering til kommunene. All fakturering til Harstad kommune og samarbeidskommuner som inngår i kontrakten, må gjennomføres i Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF). Godkjente standardformater er EHF fakturering versjon 3.0 eller nyere og PEPPOL BIS (PEPPOL Business Interoperability Specification) Billing v3.0 eller nyere. Dette dokumentet omfatter bestemmelser om hvordan elektronisk fakturering gjennomføres for Harstad kommune med samarbeidskommuner, i EHF-formatet. Dokumentet beskriver kun de spesifikke informasjonselementene kommunene sender og har behov for å motta fra leverandøren. Obligatorisk innhold i EHF3.0 omhandles ikke i denne spesifikasjonen, slik som virksomhetsadresser, mva. håndtering, kontoopplysninger og lignende. For en mer omfattende veiledning for Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF) v3.0, se: Elektronisk Handelsformat - EHF - Prosessdefinisjoner | Anskaffelser.no Spesifikasjon av felter og innhold er i

Der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband ist die Stimme der Verbraucher:innen – und damit eine entscheidende Kraft in der Politik. Wir wissen, was Verbraucher:innen bewegt und verschaffen ihnen Gehör bei Politik, Wirtschaft und Verwaltung. Strukturelle Missstände decken wir auf, benennen Verbraucherprobleme und entwickeln Lösungen. So tragen wir dazu bei, dass Märkte transparent und gerecht gestaltet werden. II. Ausgangslage Zur Selbstdarstellung und zur Unterstützung der politischen Interessenvertretung veröffentlicht der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband regelmäßig zahlreiche Kommunikationsmaterialien. Dazu zählen Publikationen, Social-Media-Grafiken, Flyer, Visuals für Veranstaltungen und Kampagnen sowie digi- tale Formate. Im Juli 2025 wurde die neue Marke Verbraucherzentrale mit einem überarbeiteten Corporate Design eingeführt. Grundlage hierfür ist die strategische Positionierung der Marke Verbraucherzentrale. Das neue Corporate Design setzt klare und verbindliche Gestaltungsstandards für die Kommunikation und unterstützt einen einheitlichen, zeit

ung. So können auch kurzfristige oder zeitkritische Projekte zuverläs- sig umgesetzt werden. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist daher der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrags für Grafikleistungen mit zwei Losen. III. Laufzeit und Umfang des Rahmenver- trags Die zu schließenden Verträge für Grafikleistungen (Los I und Los II) haben eine Laufzeit vom 01.01.2027 bis 31.12.2028. Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband e.V. 5 | 17 Leistungsbeschreibung (Anlage 1) 2026-0997 Darüber hinaus enthalten die Verträge zwei einseitige Verlängerungsoptionen für den Zeitraum vom 01.01.2029 bis 31.12.2029 und vom 01.01.2030 bis 31.12.2030. Die maximal mögliche Vertragslauf- zeit endet am 31.12.2030. Der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband hat das Recht, die Verträge durch einseitige schriftliche Erklärung bis zum 30.09. des jeweiligen Vorjahres zu verlängern, d.h. die Leistungen zu den angebo- tenen Bedingungen auch für die Jahre 2029 und 2030 zu beauftragen. Der Verbraucherzentrale Bun- desverband ist nicht dazu verpflichtet, die Optionen abzurufen. Die Ausschreibung besteht aus zwei Losen. Los I (vgl. IV.) beinhaltet Aufträge für die Konzeption von Kommunikationsmaterialien (vgl. IV.1.) und deren Umsetzung (vgl. IV.2.). Los II (vgl. references_experience.text: (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

Fixture scripts can also be used within the running application, facilitating manual/exploratory testing (discussed below). The Department also provides a number of other libraries to manage fixtures. The simple “fake data” library can be used in unit and other tests to select/generate a random value for use within a test. Integration tests should not hard-code any officer user Ids, instead the “officer leasing” library allows an unused user/officer account to be exclusively used, with logic to automatically check/reset the officer’s certificates for signed recorded actions. Production code should never use system time directly, instead it should be possible to “mock the clock” in tests. For the BOMi application the “Programmable Clock” service provides this capability. Keeping Tests Green Whenever a project starts the Department will ensure that the initial CI pipeline for their project branch (of the Trunk) is green. B2B: The DSP API and Electronic Exchange of Social Security Information (EESSI) APIs enable business-to-business integration to other Departments, public service bodies and to other European countries. Other supporting systems that make up the technology landscape include Facial Imaging Matching System (FIMS), and the General Registers Office (GRO) system. The BOMi’s scope will continue to grow in both size and complexity to (a) support the Department’s expanding Digital requirements, (b) consolidate its technology stack, and (c) continue to support new or changing legislation as it arises. The current technology platform is .NET Framework 4.x deployed to Windows Servers. In due course these will be upgraded to .NET 6 (aka .NET Core) at which time the Department will plan to deploy these systems, either for testing and/or production, on Linux/Docker when appropriate. New systems also target .NET 6 for the same purpose. The Department’s development resources are a combination of the Department’s internal staff, partnering with a number of service providers. The Senior Technical Development Advisor (TDA Lot 1) has acted as an independent strategic technical advisor across the IS Division, providing guidance on a range of SDLC and architecture related concerns. The TDA (Lot 1) helped product and platform teams deliver secure, resilient, and high-quality solutions more rapidly through the adoption of modern engineering practices and automation technologies. The TDA (Lot 1) role focused on shaping governance process and technical direction and procurement activities, translating complex technical issues into clear recommendations and implementation plans. Key areas of contribution included Continuous Integration, Release and Deployment, SDLC platform engineering, application security process and governance, Test Data Management modernisation, Developer Experience, contract testing, and SDLC platform architecture, particularly for the Department’s BOMi Platform. The TDA (Lot 1) also played a significant role in defining product and platform ownership models, associated team charters and enhanced IT governance approaches. In addition, the role supported various technical procurements through technical assessments.

We ensure that Ireland's environment is protected, and we monitor changes in environmental trends to detect early warning signs of neglect or deterioration. Protecting our environment is a huge responsibility, and we work with a number of organisations that carry out specific environmental functions. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. This commitment is reflected in our own activities through an Environmental Management System (EMS), certified to ISO 14001 since 2010, which supports good environmental management in our everyday operations. The EPA is an independent public body established under the Environmental Protection Agency Act, 1992. deliverables_scope.text: in cadrul propunerii tehnice descrierea detaliata a metodologiei proprii de management de proiect pe care o va utiliza in cadrul contractului și echipa de proiect formata din personal specializat. Ofertantul trebuie să prezinte in cadrul propunerii tehnice planul (calendarul) de derulare pentru prestarea serviciilor pe toate cele Sistemul Electronic de Achizitii Publice Sistemul Electronic de Achizitii Publice, 30.09.2026 09:38 Pagina 24 20 de luni. Planul trebuie sa conțină toate activitățile pe care le va desfășura precum și etapele/sub etapele determinante de realizare a activităților, dependentele dintre activități, reperele de proiect (milestones), rezultatele activităților și alocarea resurselor in vederea prestării serviciilor ofertate astfel încât sa fie atinse obiectivele contractului. Ofertantul trebuie să propună planul de derulare a activităților cât mai detaliat posibil și să răspundă cerințelor de etapizare și înscriere in termenele de realizare ale contractului. Planul care va fi prezentat împreuna cu oferta trebuie sa fie dezvoltat folosind tipurile de activități menționate mai sus împreuna cu alte activități considerate a fi necesare. REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST
(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTING SERVICES)

SRI LANKA
SRI LANKA PORTS AND LOGISTICS DEVELOPMENT PROJECT  

Grant No.: TF0D0285 

Assignment Title: Consultancy Service for Operational Readiness, Systems Integration, Commissioning, Go-Live Management and Operational Stabilization of East Container Terminal (ECT)

Reference No.: LK-SLPA-GFPP-577531-CS-INDV

The Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka has received financing from the World Bank
toward the Sri Lanka Ports and Logistics Development Project, and intends to apply part of the

The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate issue experience. The scope of this requirement encompasses both body and foot scanning to modernize the issuance of both uniforms and footwear. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. Waterford and Wexford Education and Training Board (WWETB) provides a comprehensive range of education and training services throughout Waterford and Wexford and is the largest education and training provider in counties Waterford and Wexford. WWETB’s educational and training provision includes second-level schools, primary school, further education colleges and a range of adult and further education centres delivering education and training programmes, Post Leaving Certificate Courses (PLCs), Youthreach centres, Outdoor Education and Youth Services. WWETB places learning and the learner at the heart of its educational provision. For more information on WWETB and ETBI go to http://waterfordwexford.etb.ie/ and www.etbi.ie For more information on ETBs and ETBI go to www.etbi.ie See Appendix 4 for details of all schools and centres under WWETB remit. entity_geography.text: σε πιστοποιημένο Κέντρο Δεδομένων επιπέδου Tier III, για 3 έτη, με δικαίωμα προαίρεσης για ακόμα 2 έτη. Στο αντικείμενο της σύμβασης περιλαμβάνεται η παροχή της απαιτούμενης υποδομής VMware, των αναγκαίων υπολογιστικών, αποθηκευτικών και δικτυακών πόρων, καθώς και η εγκατάσταση, παραμετροποίηση και λειτουργία της υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery. Οι τεχνικές προδιαγραφές τόσο του Κέντρου Δεδομένων όσο και των υπηρεσιών περιγράφονται στο Έντυπο 9 - ΠΙΝΑΚΑΣ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ. Η λύση θα υποστηρίζει τη συνεχή αναπαραγωγή (replication) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών του Πανεπιστημίου προς το περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου, με χρήση του λογισμικού Veeam Backup and Replication, ώστε να διασφαλίζεται η δυνατότητα ανάκτησης των κρίσιμων πληροφοριακών συστημάτων σε περίπτωση σοβαρής διακοπής λειτουργίας ή καταστροφής του κύριου Κέντρου Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου Κύπρου. Στόχος είναι η συνέχιση της παροχής υπηρεσιών μέσω διαδικτύου προς την Πανεπιστημιακή κοινότητα και το κοινό, με τον ελάχιστο δυνατό χρόνο διακοπής. Η λύση θα πρέπει να παρέχει τη δυνατότητα ενεργοποίησης (failover) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών στο περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου όταν και εφόσον κριθεί αναγκαίο, καθώς και δυνατότητα ασφαλούς επαναφοράς (failback) στο κύριο Κέντρο Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου μετά την αποκατάσταση

ουσας Αρχής. Κατά τη διάρκεια της επίσκεψης, τα άτομα της Αναθέτουσας Αρχής θα έχουν συναντήσεις με τους αρμόδιους μηχανικούς του DR Datacenter και θα παρουσιαστούν η υποδομή και η αρχιτεκτονική του χώρου, οι μηχανισμοί πλεονασμού και διαθεσιμότητας, καθώς και οι διαδικασίες Disaster Recovery. Παράλληλα, θα παρουσιαστούν οι διαδικασίες replication, failover/failback και αποκατάστασης των συστημάτων σε περίπτωση καταστροφής ή διακοπής λειτουργίας. Ο Ανάδοχος πρέπει να συμπεριλάβει στην προσφορά του όλα τα τυχών έξοδα για την επίσκεψη (κόστος μεταφοράς, διαμονής, γεύματα κτλ.). deliverables_scope.text: ..................... ................................ ........ 6 6 Kreditering ................................ ................................ ................................ ..... 6 1 Krav om elektronisk fakturering I medhold av Forskrift om elektronisk faktura i offentlige anskaffelser (2.april 2019) er EHF faktura obligatorisk ved fakturering til kommunene. All fakturering til Harstad kommune og samarbeidskommuner som inngår i kontrakten, må gjennomføres i Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF). Godkjente standardformater er EHF fakturering versjon 3.0 eller nyere og PEPPOL BIS (PEPPOL Business Interoperability Specification) Billing v3.0 eller nyere. Dette dokumentet omfatter bestemmelser om hvordan elektronisk fakturering gjennomføres for Harstad kommune med samarbeidskommuner, i EHF-formatet. Dokumentet beskriver kun de spesifikke informasjonselementene kommunene sender og har behov for å motta fra leverandøren. Obligatorisk innhold i EHF3.0 omhandles ikke i denne spesifikasjonen, slik som virksomhetsadresser, mva. håndtering, kontoopplysninger og lignende. For en mer omfattende veiledning for Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF) v3.0, se: Elektronisk Handelsformat - EHF - Prosessdefinisjoner | Anskaffelser.no Spesifikasjon av felter og innhold er i
